title: `nvs_memory_bytes{scope="cache"|"process"}`, `nvs_tasks_in_flight` and `nvs_deferred_trees` are seeded and never written.
text: `rule:observability/default-series` declares them, so they are present the moment an exporter is configured, and nothing sets them: they read `0` or have no member. `every_core`'s gather is where a process-wide figure can be set without a request writing it. Closing it is writing each one there, and a scrape test that reads a non-zero value for each.
